title: Kronecker-Weber Theorem Formalization: Mathlib Gap Analysis

problemStatement.formal: Every abelian extension of Q is contained in Q(zeta_n) for some n
problemStatement.plain: Can the Kronecker-Weber theorem be fully formalized in Lean/Mathlib? Survey shows the critical missing piece is class field theory (Artin reciprocity).
whyMatters: Kronecker-Weber is the complete abelian case of the inverse Galois program over Q.
The entry identifies exactly which Mathlib foundations are present and which class-field-theory components are still missing.
A precise gap analysis helps future agents avoid treating a survey scaffold as a completed theorem proof.

proven: Mathlib support for cyclotomic fields, cyclotomic polynomial irreducibility over Q, and related Galois constructions is documented.
The survey identifies the expected Kronecker-Weber target: every abelian extension of Q is contained in a cyclotomic extension.
Existing formal infrastructure around cyclotomic Galois groups and finite inverse-Galois examples is cataloged.
The entry distinguishes actual sorry tactics from comment mentions of "sorry-free", avoiding inflated proof-health claims.
open: Kronecker-Weber itself is not fully formalized in the current development.
Core class field theory is missing, including Artin reciprocity, ideles/adeles, ray class groups, ray class fields, and local class field theory.
A future proof must either axiomatize Artin reciprocity cleanly or build an alternate ramification/discriminant route from available Mathlib infrastructure.
knownResults.goal: Preserve this as a Mathlib gap-analysis entry for Kronecker-Weber rather than presenting it as a completed formal proof.

currentState.focus: OQ mislabeled: sorry counts inflated by comment mentions. InverseGalois.lean has 0 actual sorry tactics. OQ01 has 1 sorry for open problem (intentional).
currentState.nextAction: Read problem.md thoroughly and acquire full context.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED (mislabeled OQ): Sorry counts in JSON are inflated by comment mentions of "sorry-free". Actual sorry count: InverseGalois.lean=0, InverseGaloisOQ01.lean=1 (intentional open problem), InverseGaloisA5ResultantDet.lean=1.
builtItems: Gap analysis: identified class field theory as critical missing piece
Documented Mathlib support: cyclotomic fields (full), Galois theory (full), ramification groups (partial), p-adic numbers (full)
Documented Mathlib gaps: Artin reciprocity, ideles/adeles, ray class groups, local class field theory
Identified existing axiomatizations in KroneckersJugendtraum.lean and Hilbert9Reciprocity.lean
insights: JSON sorry counts include comment mentions — InverseGalois.lean reports 11 but has 0 actual sorry tactics
The 1 sorry in InverseGaloisOQ01.lean is intentional: inverse Galois problem is OPEN
Kronecker-Weber gap analysis is a survey task, not a sorry-elimination task
mathlibGaps: No class field theory (Artin reciprocity, Artin map)
No ray class groups or ray class field construction
No local fields as a typeclass (only p-adic numbers specifically)
No local class field theory or local Artin map
nextSteps: Consider axiomatizing Artin reciprocity as a clean axiom and proving KW from it
Alternatively: prove KW via the Minkowski bound approach (ramification + discriminant)
Check if the ramification-theoretic approach is feasible with existing Mathlib ramification groups
